text:
I am a roofing contractor🔨,  and this is how I used Grok @bot over the last 2 days:

1)  Filled out and pulled an online roofing permit
2) Filled out and booked a roof inspection via online form (with captcha)
3) Filled out and emailed (2) job notification forms to my insurance co.
4) Built/sent via e-signature a subcontract
5) Pulled roof measurements for a new inbound lead, and built out a full proposal/estimate with contract staged pending approval.
6) Filled out, drafted, and emailed (2) change orders via e-signature
7) Found a discrepancy in my subcontractors insurance certificates, and drafted/sent an email to their insurance brokers for the correct info
8) Wrote a work order for a subcontractor based on a customer contract, and built out a materials list. 
9) Filled out a credit application for a new supplier and found/emailed it to the right person

ALL IN TWO DAYS guys.... and thats just on the operations side
